headline_hook: Google Ships Lyria 3.5 as AI Worms Burrow Through Copilot and Frontier Labs Blink
preview_topics: frontier labs jointly urge pacing AI

pick_of_the_day.thesis: The document-borne AI worm isn't just a clever exploit — it reveals that every enterprise document ecosystem with copilot access is now an attack surface, and the implicit trust chains organizations built by giving AI read-write permissions are the real vulnerability.

model_literacy.relevance: Today's AI worm exploits the fact that LLMs cannot distinguish instructions from data in documents they process — when your copilot reads an infected doc, malicious instructions execute as if they were user commands, then propagate to new documents. Builders integrating document-processing AI need to understand this trust boundary failure.
